geometry: Unmodified production WALL_ONLY STL; exact-coordinate welding only; port caps excluded
triangle_identity: Lexicographic vertex coordinate IDs; canonical sorted vertex-ID triple for face IDs; labels never choose the physical normal
adjacency: Shared manifold edge, consistent local orientation, dihedral <= threshold. Region labels are diagnostics only. Group local nearest candidates, never whole global connected component.

normal.orientation: flip toward query center relative to weighted candidate closest point; zero/cancelled orientation stops
normal.limitation: Mesh defines piecewise planar geometry. Pseudonormals identify smooth continuation; no analytic surface or mesh smoothing is claimed.
normal.finite_radius_contact: At a single smooth edge/vertex/patch use the center-to-weighted-feature distance gradient for the sphere offset constraint; retain weighted face pseudonormal separately for orientation and diagnostics. Face interior and true multi patches use their face pseudonormals.

activation: Full raw swept segment unsafe; binary search monotone prefix safety (40 iterations) for predicted first contact; query there
projection: Enumerate active sets of size 0..3, solve small Gram KKT, all normals feasible, choose minimum Euclidean translation change
raw_resistance: R_bulk+R_BB_excess; coefficients/PCG/hard pair KKT unchanged; twist pending
safety: Inherited exact segment-to-triangle continuous minimum distance after projection and correction; final endpoint plus pair sweep

position_correction.conditions: single cluster at first contact and endpoint, projected inward motion, prior actual wall retry, positive tiny endpoint OR swept residual deficit
position_correction.direction: center minus cluster-weighted closest point, normalized
position_correction.limit: one correction per stage; corrected full swept certificate must pass; multi-surface correction disabled

rollback: Entire trial/controller/RNG/admissions rollback; dt halves physical interval; no held-position time advance
fatal_archive: WALL_CONTACT_FAILURE.json flushes full query topology, normals, velocities, stage, dt and exact swept gaps before stop
